mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a monetary easing cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by >1% indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a rise in unemployment rate by >0.2pp signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in low unemployment regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.25pp) and inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.2% monthly) signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises >0.2%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals recessionary labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
